about.heroTitle: The trusted partner for professional kitchens
about.heroSubtitle: 2MC Gastro provides commercial kitchen equipment, smart planning tools and end-to-end project support to gastronomy professionals — from restaurants and hotels to cafés and large-scale catering facilities.

story.title: Who We Are
story.p1: 2MC Gastro is a Germany-based supplier of commercial kitchen equipment. With a team that knows the gastronomy industry inside out, we aim to deliver the right equipment at the right price — whatever the size of your business.
story.p2: What sets us apart is an approach that goes beyond selling: we manage the entire journey from product selection to kitchen layout, from quotation to delivery. With our 2D and 3D kitchen design studio you can see your kitchen before it is built and place your equipment at true scale.
story.p3: We bring together more than 14,000 products from leading European brands such as Diamond, CombiSteel and HENDI under one roof — and with our digital catalog, instant quotation system and a platform available in 15 languages, we make purchasing transparent and fast.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To take the complexity out of building a professional kitchen and turn it into a transparent, enjoyable experience that every business can access — with the right equipment, smart planning and honest pricing.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To become Europe's first-choice digital partner for gastronomy equipment — redefining the standard of kitchen planning by combining technology with deep industry knowledge.

values.title: Our Values
values.subtitle: The principles that guide us in every project

quality.title: Quality
quality.text: We only work with proven, durable and certified equipment. We stand behind every product we sell.

trust.title: Transparency
trust.text: Clear prices, clear delivery times, clear communication. Surprise costs and vague promises are not our style.

technology.title: Technology
technology.text: From 3D kitchen design to instant PDF quotes — we digitalize our processes to save you time and money.

partnership.title: Partnership
partnership.text: We see ourselves as a solution partner, not just a supplier. We stay at your side long after your kitchen opens.

services.title: What We Do
services.subtitle: Everything under one roof — from equipment selection to your kitchen's opening day

supply.title: Equipment Supply
supply.text: More than 14,000 commercial kitchen products, from cooking to refrigeration, warewashing to preparation — through our reliable supply chain.

design.title: 2D & 3D Kitchen Design
design.text: Draw your kitchen, add doors and windows, place equipment at true scale and walk through it in 3D. Your design stays in sync with your projects automatically.

quote.title: Quotes & Project Management
quote.text: Create a professional PDF quote from your cart or project in minutes, and track revisions in one place.

delivery.title: Delivery & Support

compare.faqInstallQ: Is installation included when I buy from {{name}}?

compare.faqInstallANo: {{name}} typically only sells products; installation is left to the customer. 2MC Gastro offers a full turnkey service including delivery, installation, training and service warranty.
compare.faqTurkishQ: Which platform is better suited to Turkish businesses?

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: A single source for professional kitchens: products, planning, quotes.
about.intro1: 2MC Gastro is a Cologne-based supplier of commercial kitchen equipment. We bring together products from leading manufacturers — Diamond, CombiSteel and HENDI in particular — in one catalogue for restaurants, hotels, cafés, catering and canteen operations.
about.intro2: We do more than sell equipment: our 2D/3D kitchen planner helps you lay out the space with us, produces a quote (Angebot) from your project in one click, and lets you follow the process from order to delivery.

offering.item2: Free 2D/3D kitchen planning and layout advice

duration.p: Stock items are usually dispatched within a few working days. Lead times vary for items sourced from the manufacturer; the estimated delivery time is stated on your order confirmation.

acceptance.p: Please inspect the packaging on delivery. If there is visible damage, note it on the delivery receipt, take photos where possible and notify us immediately; otherwise a transport-damage claim becomes difficult.

fees.p: Shipping charges are calculated based on the size and weight of the item and the delivery address, and are shown as a separate line in the quote/cart. Prices are quoted net (excl. VAT) for B2B.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we process your personal data under the GDPR (DSGVO).

hosting.p: The website is hosted on Vercel Inc. infrastructure. On each access, the IP address, date/time, page requested, browser and operating system are written to server logs as a technical necessity (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR — legitimate interest in secure operation) and deleted shortly afterwards.

data.p: When you register, your name, email, company and contact details, along with the projects, quotes and orders you create, are stored on Supabase (database and authentication). The purpose of processing is the conclusion and performance of the contract (Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR). Data is retained until your account is deleted or the statutory retention periods expire.

payment.p: Card payments are processed by Stripe Payments Europe Ltd.; card data does not reach us. Stripe acts as controller under its own privacy policy.

contact.p: Information you send us via the support form or by email is processed to respond to your enquiry (Art. 6 (1) (b) and (f) GDPR) and deleted within a reasonable period after the correspondence has concluded.

cookies.p: Strictly necessary cookies/storage (session, language, cart, cookie preference) do not require consent. Usage analytics (PostHog) are only activated when you consent in the cookie banner; if you don't consent, tracking stays off. See the "Cookies" page for details.

rights.p: You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection; you may withdraw any consent given at any time. Requests can be sent to the email address above. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (for Germany: Landesbeauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit NRW).

terms.title: Terms of Use (AGB)
terms.subtitle: General terms of sale and use for commercial customers.

scope.p: These terms apply to all offers, orders and deliveries between {{legalName}} ("2MC Gastro") and the customer. The platform is intended primarily for commercial customers (entrepreneurs within the meaning of § 14 BGB); prices are shown net, excluding VAT ("zzgl. MwSt.").

contract.p: Product displays on the site do not constitute a binding offer. Placing an order constitutes an offer on your part; the contract is concluded by our order confirmation or delivery. Quotes (Angebote) generated on the platform are valid for the period stated.

price.p: Prices are in euros and exclude shipping costs. Payment is made by advance payment (Vorkasse), card (Stripe) or, subject to agreement, by invoice. Statutory default interest applies on overdue payments.

delivery.p: Delivery times are estimates and are stated on the order confirmation. The goods remain our property until paid for in full (Eigentumsvorbehalt). For commercial customers, the risk of carriage passes to the customer on handover of the goods to the carrier.

warranty.p: The statutory rules on liability for defects apply. Commercial customers are obliged to inspect the goods without delay and notify apparent defects promptly (§ 377 HGB). Manufacturer warranties apply in addition.

liability.p: We are liable without limitation for intent and gross negligence and for damage to life, body and health. Otherwise, liability is limited to the breach of essential contractual obligations and to foreseeable damage typical for the contract.

platform.p: You are required to keep your account credentials confidential. The planner and catalogue data may only be used for your own projects; bulk copying and automated scraping of content are prohibited.

law.p: German law applies; the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG) is excluded. For merchants, the place of jurisdiction is Cologne.

cancellation.title: Right of Withdrawal (Widerrufsrecht)
cancellation.subtitle: 14-day right of withdrawal information for consumers.

who.p: The statutory right of withdrawal only applies to consumers (§ 13 BGB). There is no statutory right of withdrawal for businesses ordering for commercial purposes (§ 14 BGB); return conditions are subject to separate agreement.

info.p1: Consumers may withdraw from this contract within 14 days, without stating any reason, from the day on which the goods were received. To withdraw, it is sufficient to notify us (address and email below) of your decision by a clear statement (e.g. email); the model form below may be used, but is not mandatory.
info.p2: In the event of withdrawal, we will refund all payments received from you, including the standard cost of return shipping, within 14 days of receipt of the withdrawal notice. We may withhold the refund until we have received the goods or you have supplied evidence of having sent them. You must return the goods within 14 days; for items delivered by freight (pallet), the return costs are yours. You are liable for any loss of value resulting from handling of the goods beyond what is necessary to establish their nature, characteristics and functioning.

changePreference.p: You can delete cookies and site data at any time in your browser settings. To withdraw consent, simply clear the site data; the cookie banner will reappear on your next visit.

s1.title: Scope
s1.p1: These General Terms and Conditions (GTC) apply to the sale of products and services by 2MC Gastro GmbH to commercial customers (B2B). These GTC form the basis for all legal transactions between the provider and the buyer.
s1.p2: Any deviating terms of the buyer apply only if expressly accepted by the provider in writing.

s2.p1: The display of products on the website constitutes an offer. By placing an order, the buyer makes a binding offer.
